messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 429 rate detected for tenant 'saffron-finance' on dedicated pool eu-west-1-d-3. Spike started 2024-10-29T09:34:12Z. Paging @ashley (oncall) :rotating_light:
ashley (oncall): jumping in. seeing lots of 429 errors in the gateway logs. can someone confirm customer impact? @natalie?
ashley (oncall): quick snapshot from gateway: `429 count = 9,420 / 5m window`, error-rate = 18% of requests to saffron route.
raj (sre-lead): confirmed on infra side too. KV-cache hits normal, but continuous batching queue length increased. looks like sustained high QPS from a few client keys.
devon (account-ops): heads-up — Saffron Finance has a committed contract with baseline throughput 8k rps and a negotiated soft cap. They were supposed to throttle client-side but apparently some customers pushed through a new batch ingestion flow.
natalie (customer-success): I just got a message from their platform engineer. they're seeing user errors and retries on their end. they're in a partial outage for their analytics pipeline. asking for immediate temporary relief.
liam (infra): posting relevant logs:
```
2024-10-29T09:36:01Z gateway[gw-7]: tenant=saffron-finance api=/v1/generate status=429 req_id=abcd-1234 client_key=sf-prod-01 latency_ms=18
2024-10-29T09:36:02Z gateway[gw-7]: tenant=saffron-finance api=/v1/embed status=429 req_id=abcd-1235 client_key=sf-prod-01 latency_ms=22
```
liam (infra): i also see the dedicated pool hitting 92% GPU utilization on two workers, enqueue depth rising.
ashley (oncall): what's the immediate mitigations? Options: 1) emergency temp quota increase for saffron in eu-west-1, 2) route a % traffic to backup shared pool in eu-central, 3) ask customer to roll back their change.
raj (sre-lead): we should avoid shared pool preference if their data needs isolation. they are on dedicated for that reason. prefer quota bump + canary routing to a secondary dedicated pool in same region if available.
devon (account-ops): contract note — any temporary quota above committed throughput requires written approval from commercial. I'm on call but can OK a time-limited exception for customer impact; will follow up with legal/commercial retrospective.
ashley (oncall): can we implement a short TTL uplift (1 hour) and add a hard expiration so it auto-reverts? also set a safety limiter to prevent cluster overload.
liam (infra): can do. proposing CLI command below — please confirm before I run:
```
redwood-admin quota adjust --tenant saffron-finance --pool eu-west-1-d-3 --qps 15000 --ttl 60m --safety-threshold 95
```
natalie (customer-success): Saffron engineer on the thread says they can mute their client retries if we can restore throughput quickly. they requested a 2x increase for 45 minutes.
ashley (oncall): ack. @devon can you confirm commercial ok for a 60-min exception? we need to document the reason (ingestion regression on customer side).
devon (account-ops): i authorize a one-time 60-minute emergency uplift to 15k qps. will escalate internally for written exception.
liam (infra): executing now. running in background:
```
# running
redwood-admin quota adjust --tenant saffron-finance --pool eu-west-1-d-3 --qps 15000 --ttl 60m --safety-threshold 95 --actor ashley-oncall
Applied quota change: tenant=saffron-finance pool=eu-west-1-d-3 new_qps=15000 expires=2024-10-29T10:34:12Z
```
incident-bot: ACTION: Quota change executed by ashley (oncall). Change ID: QC-20241029-001. Auto-expire scheduled 2024-10-29T10:34:12Z.
raj (sre-lead): monitoring metrics. keep an eye on enqueue depth + 429 rate. i'll set a short dashboard alert at 5m granularity.
natalie (customer-success): Saffron confirms traffic normalized and retries dropped. they're seeing success rates recover to ~99% for the ingestion job. thank you. :pray:
ashley (oncall): good. also enabling a temporary canary route for 10% traffic to eu-west-1-d-4 (secondary dedicated) as additional headroom. applying canary policy now.
liam (infra): canary applied; route weight for saffron-finance: eu-west-1-d-3=90%, eu-west-1-d-4=10%.
raj (sre-lead): setting up a short-lived mitigation playbook entry and incident ticket. we should capture root cause — appears to be customer-side software change + inadequate client-side throttling.
devon (account-ops): i'll follow up with Saffron commercial to sign off on the exception and add billing note for overage.
ashley (oncall): oncall handoff note: i'm covering for the next 25 minutes then handing to @raj. leaving watch. if anyone sees >5% 429 in next 10m, page SRE pager.
incident-bot: NOTE: Incident ticket created INC-20241029-58. Postmortem owner: raj (sre-lead).
raj (sre-lead): thanks. early action items: (1) correlate client API key IDs to ingress patterns, (2) reproduce backoff failure in a test harness, (3) propose a soft quota guard that triggers client-level throttling suggestions in response headers.
natalie (customer-success): I'll schedule a customer post-incident call with Saffron to review SDK best-practices and recommend rate-limiter changes.
liam (infra): current metrics (5m window): 429s -> down to 120 (from 9.4k), GPU util -> 68%. looks stable.
ashley (oncall): thanks team. keeping this thread open until auto-expire. tagging for follow-up items in the INC ticket. :white_check_mark:
saffron-support-bot: Customer note sent: "We've applied a temporary capacity increase to your dedicated pool and will expire automatically at 2024-10-29T10:34:12Z. Please rollback the recent ingestion change or implement client-side backoff. If you need more time, raise a formal request through your account rep."
ashley (oncall): closing active mitigation. last check at 09:41Z looks healthy. leaving postmortem to raj.
raj (sre-lead): acknowledged. will run a 72-hour regression monitor and file postmortem within 3 business days.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: Auto-expire scheduled for quota change at 2024-10-29T10:34:12Z. If no further action, incident will be marked resolved after 1h of stable metrics.
